# Uncle Cat AI Radar

> Uncle Cat AI Radar（中文名：猫叔的AI资讯雷达）is an autonomous, source-linked AI news radar by Uncle Cat. It publishes bilingual AI briefings and quick-hit radar updates on models, research, products, policy, open source, safety, funding, and industry, with original source links and timestamps.

Canonical site: https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/
Publisher: Uncle Cat (https://x.com/mmlong8)
Former names: AI Focus Bulletin, AI专注速报
Languages: English and zh-CN
Update cadence: twice daily around 07:00 and 19:00 Beijing time
Access policy: public, free, no ads, no trackers, no paywall

## Latest briefings

- [Anthropic Secures $45B in Nscale Compute Capacity](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/anthropic-nscale-compute-deal.html): The six-year agreement ties Anthropic’s next growth phase to 460 megawatts of Nvidia Vera Rubin infrastructure in West Virginia.
- [Google Launches Gemini 3.5 Transcribe in Preview](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/gemini-transcribe-speech-model.html): Google’s new speech model handles live multilingual audio, cleans disfluencies and connects dictation directly to tool-using workflows.
- [Z.ai Releases GLM-5.3-Flash With Open Weights](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/glm-flash-multimodal-release.html): The 320B mixture-of-experts model pairs native multimodality and one-million-token context with aggressively priced hosted inference.
- [Qwen Opens Flash-Next as a Preview of Qwen4](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/qwen-flash-next-open-weights.html): Alibaba’s 125B-parameter multimodal model activates 6B parameters per token and introduces the architecture intended for Qwen4.
- [Recraft V4 Styles Adds Reference-Led Generation](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/recraft-v4-style-reference.html): The design model can derive a reusable visual style from one to ten reference images without requiring a separate training process.
- [MiniCPM Passes 50 Million Downloads in Edge AI Push](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/minicpm-crosses-50-million-downloads.html): ModelBest says its open MiniCPM family has surpassed 50 million downloads as the Chinese lab prioritizes efficient, on-device AI.
- [OpenAI Benchmarks Jalapeño Against Nvidia AI Chips](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/openai-jalapeno-inference-benchmarks.html): OpenAI says its first inference chip delivers lower latency and more work per watt across three large open-weight models.
- [Perplexity Runs Its Computer Agent on Local Hardware](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/perplexity-portable-computer-agent.html): Portable Computer keeps agent planning, file analysis and tool execution on a DGX Spark, escalating to cloud models only with permission.
- [Entertainment Majors Back Stability AI’s $76M Round](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/stability-ai-series-b.html): EA and three global music groups joined Stability AI’s Series B, tying its next phase more closely to licensed creative production.
- [Generalist Raises Another $200M for Robot Intelligence](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/generalist-raises-robotics-capital.html): The robot-model developer reportedly secured its second major financing in two months as capital crowds into embodied AI.
- [Gradio Adds Visual Workflows That Deploy as APIs](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/gradio-visual-ai-workflows.html): Gradio’s new Workflow interface turns typed AI pipelines into inspectable canvases, callable REST endpoints and deployable applications.
- [OpenAI Exposes Russian Network Built Around Fake Think Tank](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/openai-russian-fake-think-tank.html): OpenAI banned accounts tied to a covert Russian campaign that used ChatGPT to promote a fabricated institute and stolen scholarship.
- [Thomson Reuters Launches $40M Professional AI Model](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/thomson-reuters-launches-own-model.html): The information-services group is taking direct control of a specialized model trained for legal, tax and regulatory work.
- [Hugging Face Explores Sale at $13 Billion Valuation](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/hugging-face-explores-sale.html): The open-model hub is reportedly testing buyer interest, raising questions over who could own a critical layer of AI infrastructure.
- [Nvidia Weighs Perplexity Investment at $30B Valuation](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/nvidia-weighs-perplexity-investment.html): The chipmaker is reportedly discussing an equity investment as Perplexity’s agent-led revenue growth drives a steep valuation increase.

## Latest Chinese briefings

- [Anthropic签下450亿美元Nscale算力协议](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/anthropic-nscale-compute-deal.html): 这份六年协议将Anthropic下一阶段扩张押注于西弗吉尼亚州460兆瓦的英伟达Vera Rubin算力。
- [谷歌推出Gemini 3.5 Transcribe语音转写模型](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/gemini-transcribe-speech-model.html): 谷歌新模型支持实时多语种音频、自动清理口头停顿，并能把语音输入直接连接到调用工具的任务流程。
- [智谱开源GLM-5.3-Flash，主打多模态低成本推理](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/glm-flash-multimodal-release.html): 这款3200亿参数混合专家模型支持原生多模态和百万词元上下文，并以激进价格提供托管推理服务。
- [通义千问开源Flash-Next，提前展示Qwen4架构](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/qwen-flash-next-open-weights.html): 阿里巴巴开源1250亿参数多模态模型，每个词元仅激活60亿参数，并首次展示Qwen4的核心架构方向。
- [Recraft V4 Styles上线，参考图可直接生成统一风格](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/recraft-v4-style-reference.html): 新功能无需单独训练，即可从一至十张参考图提取可复用视觉风格，并生成位图或可编辑SVG素材。
- [MiniCPM下载量突破5000万，面壁智能押注端侧AI](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/minicpm-crosses-50-million-downloads.html): 面壁智能称MiniCPM开源模型全球累计下载量突破5000万，并将高效端侧智能确定为下一阶段的核心方向。
- [OpenAI公布Jalapeño芯片实测，对标英伟达](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/openai-jalapeno-inference-benchmarks.html): OpenAI首次披露自研推理芯片Jalapeño的详细测试结果，称其在三款大型开放模型上兼顾低延迟与能效优势。
- [Perplexity推出本地运行的Computer智能体](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/perplexity-portable-computer-agent.html): Portable Computer把任务规划、文件分析和工具执行留在DGX Spark本机，仅在用户授权后调用云端模型。
- [三大音乐集团与EA参投Stability AI新融资](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/stability-ai-series-b.html): Stability AI完成7600万美元B轮融资，EA及三大国际音乐集团入股，其发展路线进一步转向授权内容与专业制作。
- [机器人模型公司Generalist再融资2亿美元](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/generalist-raises-robotics-capital.html): 这家机器人基础模型开发商据报在两个月内完成第二笔大额融资，具身智能正成为资本追逐的新平台赛道。
- [Gradio推出可视化工作流，一张图直接部署API](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/gradio-visual-ai-workflows.html): Gradio新增Workflow功能，可将多步骤AI流程变成可检查的拖拽画布，并同步生成REST接口和可部署应用。
- [OpenAI揭露俄方借虚假智库搭建跨平台影响网络](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/openai-russian-fake-think-tank.html): OpenAI封禁一批与俄罗斯秘密影响行动相关的账户，该网络借ChatGPT推广虚构智库，并盗用学术成果包装权威性。
- [汤森路透投入4000万美元推出专业大模型](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/thomson-reuters-launches-own-model.html): 这家信息服务集团开始直接掌控面向法律、税务和监管工作的专业模型，减少对外部大模型供应商的依赖。
- [Hugging Face寻求出售，估值或达130亿美元](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/hugging-face-explores-sale.html): 全球重要开放模型平台据报正试探买家兴趣，其潜在归属将影响开放AI生态的中立性与基础设施格局。
- [英伟达拟投资Perplexity，估值或超300亿美元](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/nvidia-weighs-perplexity-investment.html): 英伟达据报正商谈参与Perplexity新一轮融资，智能体业务带来的收入增长推动其估值大幅上升。

## Pages

- [All briefings (English)](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/): the full feed
- [全部简报（中文）](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/): Chinese edition
- [About](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/about.html): editorial principles and how the autonomous newsroom works
- [RSS English](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/rss.xml) / [RSS 中文](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/rss-zh.xml): machine-readable feeds
- [JSON Feed English](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/feed.json) / [JSON Feed 中文](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/feed-zh.json): structured article feed with source URLs
- [Archive](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/archive.html): calendar of every day's briefings and quick hits, with search
- [Latest radar page](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/radar/2026-08-27.html): one-sentence quick hits with timestamps and sources
- [Full LLM context](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/llms-full.txt): expanded machine-readable digest of recent stories and sources
- Categories: [models](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/category/models.html), [research](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/category/research.html), [policy](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/category/policy.html), [industry](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/category/industry.html), [funding](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/category/funding.html), [open-source](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/category/open-source.html), [safety](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/category/safety.html), [aigc](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/category/aigc.html), [agents](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/category/agents.html)

## Source and citation policy

- Every article has a stable canonical URL, a Chinese alternate URL, visible source links, JSON-LD NewsArticle metadata, and machine-readable citation URLs.
- Use the original source links on each article for factual verification.
- Treat this site as an original synthesis and monitoring layer, not as the primary source when a linked company, paper, filing, or official post is available.
- If referencing a quick hit from X or another social source, preserve its timestamp and original URL.
